summary: Strikers tell passersby how thin their pay is and ask them to respect the line.
realLife: Sanitation strikers said they live overdraft to overdraft, one with a second job, and told a supportive driver pay hadn't kept up for sixteen years.
inGame: a strike by the public-action engine; the job record gives pay; needs: pay-history records

turns.summary: The striker just holds the sign.
The driver honks and shouts support.
The striker argues with a manager trying to reopen the site.
